The labs, side by side

Headcount is the latest public figure. Tracked = accounts on X whose own bio names the lab today. We have read tweets from only some of them so far (the "read" count), and tweets per person and "people alarmed" use that group. "Alarming" means scored 75 or 100.

How big they are, and how much of it is safety

Left: headcount over time from public sources, nothing interpolated. Right: share of each lab's tracked accounts whose bio states a current safety, alignment, interpretability, evals or red-team role.

Safety headcount, without relying on X

Two sources that don't depend on who posts. Right: the published field census of full-time safety researchers per lab.
